art_direction: 绯夜回声：28岁成年原创女性，深樱桃红高马尾、灰绿眼睛、黑白骑行夹克，腰侧托着深蓝头盔、另一手搭停稳机车车座；暖白面光和电青玫红边光分离，雨后霓虹倒影衬托清晰英气面容。
composition_variation: Near-frontal head-to-upper-thigh portrait beside a parked motorcycle, slight weight shift and shoulder-to-hip counterturn; one forearm cradles helmet below chest and opposite hand rests on seat. Clear two-arm silhouette.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory jewel-cherry-rainlight/native. Canonical wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.hair: Deep cherry-red high ponytail with ruby-magenta highlights
wallpaper.title: 绯夜回声 · 雨光骑手
wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 1220x1280 contact sheet with full wallpaper, enlarged face and helmet/hand detail. One adult original woman with cherry-red ponytail, clear gray-green eyes, natural slight smile and coherent face shading. Two sleeved arms; near hand supports helmet lower rim with coherent visible fingers, far hand is mostly occluded at the right edge near the motorcycle. Single well-formed helmet with cyan/magenta visor reflections. Opaque black-white jacket and dark clothing, no text, watermark, extra limbs or additional people. Composition is tight at the top; clock clearance is less than the requested 20 percent.

visible_description: 樱桃红高马尾女性穿黑白骑行夹克，腰侧托着深蓝头盔，回头露出轻快浅笑；灰绿眼睛清晰，电青和玫红灯带映在面罩与雨后街面上。
